senses.en_definition: Physical strength or energy that enables a person to move, work, or act.
Effort or labour devoted to a task or activity.
People employed or engaged in a particular type of work; personnel.
Energy that can be transferred or converted to produce physical effects or do work.

messages.en: Where are you? I haven't got the energy to walk any further. Can we take a quick break?
I'm at that bench up ahead. Come over here and let's rest for a bit. I've got some extra water.

senses.en_definition: Calm or still, with no waves or disturbance; subsided, of wind or a storm.
Calm and free from anxiety or agitation; peaceful and orderly, of a situation.

messages.en: I'm worried about tomorrow's results. I've been going over the same thing in my head for a while now.
Want me to give you a quick call? We can have a chat. It might help you feel a bit better.
Thanks for hearing me out earlier. I feel a bit calmer after talking to you.

senses.en_definition: The middle or centre; the part between two sides or ends.

collocations.en: in the middle of the road; on the way
in the middle of the field

senses.en_definition: Currently engaged in an action or activity; in the process of doing something.
Among a group of people or amid particular surroundings or circumstances.

collocations.en: in the midst of a crowd

senses.en_definition: Intermediate in birth order, between the eldest and the youngest.

collocations.en: the middle one of the younger siblings

senses.en_definition: Half; the midpoint of a period, as in fixed expressions for noon and midnight.

messages.en: Are you free? I wanted to give you a quick call.
I'm having a meal out right now. I'll call you back when I'm done, okay?
Okay, enjoy your food. It's nothing urgent.

senses.en_definition: To look at something or go and check on it.
To watch a film, programme, or performance.
To visit someone, especially someone who is ill.

collocations.en: go and visit one's younger brother or sister

senses.en_definition: To divine someone's fortune or predict good or bad luck.

messages.en: Have you seen that movie yet? The one we were talking about the other day.
Not yet. Want to go see it tonight? I finish work at seven.
Let's do it! Let's go for the nine o'clock showing so we've got time to eat first.
